description: This is a test class for HibernateProviderDAO, specifically testing the methods that retrieve Provider objects by Person, including handling of retired providers. It extends BaseContextSensitiveTest, indicating it runs within a certain test context.

classes.name: HibernateProviderDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HibernateProviderDAO, testing provider retrieval operations

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads data, and sets up the ProviderService and personDao instances before each test.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldNotReturnRetiredProvidersIfIncludeRetiredFalse
methods.description: Tests that the method getProvidersByPerson excludes retired providers when includeRetired is false.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldListRetiredProvidersAtTheEnd
methods.description: Tests that retired providers are included when includeRetired is true, and are positioned at the end of the list.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldReturnAllProvidersIfIncludeRetiredTrue
methods.description: Tests that all providers, including retired ones, are returned when includeRetired is true.
